messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — MidBank POC wants compliance artifacts for procurement: SOC 2 Type II summary, ISO27001 scope, signed pen-test attestation, and a sanitized network diagram. They want to fast-track this for a Friday procurement meeting.
maria: We do. Typically: (1) NDA signed, (2) redact IPs and account identifiers, (3) provide SOC2 summary + control mapping, (4) ISO cert + scope PDF, (5) one-page pen-test attestation (internal OK for POC), and (6) sample VPC peering snippet. We also include a short onboarding runbook excerpt.
alex: Timeline? Procurement wants docs by Friday morning.
maria: If NDA by tomorrow EOD, we can assemble and deliver Friday AM. If NDA slips, we can still send the VPC snippet/sample SGs immediately (no secret info). Redacted SOC2 and ISO cert take ~24hrs to prepare; attestation one-pager can be done within a business day.
security-bot: created ticket EVID-2026-114 assigned to maria. Due: 48h after NDA.
jeff: Clarify: does the pen-test attestation need third-party sign-off? Procurement asked if an external vendor letter is required.
maria: For POC, internal attestation signed by our Head of Security/CISO is sufficient. We'll indicate in the attestation that a third-party pen-test report is available under production procurement or upon NDA+contract. We'll also add a note on scope (POC vs prod).
alex: I'll coordinate with legal to push the NDA. Also can we include a short table showing which controls are met in the POC environment vs production?
maria: Yes — we'll attach a small control-matrix CSV (SOC2 controls on rows, POC status: Supported/Restricted/Not Applicable) so procurement can see gaps.
alex: Great. Send me drafts for review before sharing. Aim to minimize redactions but ensure no sensitive identifiers.
jeff: For the network diagram, prefer a sanitized PNG. I can scrub IPs and account IDs.
maria: I'll assemble: SOC2 summary (redacted), ISO cert+scope.pdf, pen-test attestation one-pager (signed by CISO), sanitized network diagram, VPC peering terraform snippet, and control matrix CSV. Delivery conditional on NDA.
alex: Thanks team. I'll update MidBank and ask them to sign the NDA tonight.
maria: Noted, will standby. If they insist on external pen-test for POC, we escalate to sales leadership.
alex: Noted. Outsource not ideal for quick POC. Thanks everyone :pray:
security-bot: EVID-2026-114 updated: waiting on NDA
